_note: FLWO 60-inch (Tillinghast) with TRES: one telescope in one dome.
One file for the enclosure, read by both services (robofast/config.py):
python -m robofast.supervisor_service --config sites/flwo60/flwo60.json
python -m robofast.sequencer_service --config sites/flwo60/flwo60.json
Every address is a 127.0.0.1 placeholder.
tillinghast.telescope: the TCSGO server (sites/flwo60/tcsgo.json listens on 11140).
tillinghast.camera: the TRES CCD's Alpaca camera (to be written; placeholder).
tillinghast.calstage: the TRES front end's calibration stage (sites/flwo60/tres_frontend.json listens on 11160; docs/tres_frontend.md).

tillinghast.lamps: the TRES calibration lamps on the Pulizzi switch (sites/flwo60/pulizzi.json listens on 11170; docs/pulizzi.md): ARC and LAMP_FLAT requests. calstage per lamp: 'science' (lamp light into the science fiber; tres_frontend.json). warmup (s) per lamp: placeholders, unconfirmed.
tillinghast.adc: the atmospheric dispersion corrector's tracking switch (sites/flwo60/adc.json listens on 11180; docs/adc.md): tracking on before light frames, off (prisms neutral) at cleanup.
dome: the 60-inch dome's Alpaca server; the TCSGO server's dome/0 if the TCS drives the dome (unconfirmed), else its own server.
safetymonitor, observingconditions: a weather bridge for Mt. Hopkins (placeholder).
No hardware heartbeat: the TCS has none, and the dome has no watchdog (JDE 2026-10-31: none he is aware of), so nothing closes the dome if the supervisor dies.

So safety.attended_only (also the default without a heartbeat): no lease, and the dome never opens, unless an operator is on duty through the observer console ('on duty', renewed while the page is open). duty_ttl s without a renewal: a critical alarm; duty_grace s later the supervisor closes (docs/console.md, Operator duty).
tillinghast.limits: the observer console's manual-slew altitude limits (deg); min_alt follows tcsgo.json (placeholder, unconfirmed).
site: the 60-inch on Mt. Hopkins, approximate (public).

mode: attended (JDE 2026-10-31: the dome has no watchdog). The enclosure is attended_only, so the built-in robotic mode is not offered here and no mode may open without an operator on duty (docs/modes.md); engineering (manual control only) and shadow (log what it would do, command nothing) are.

lamps.lamps.*.max_on: repeats each outlet's max_on in pulizzi.json (placeholders there too), so the sequences below are checked against it when this file is loaded; the switch's own limit is checked again before a lamp goes on.

sequences (docs/sequences.md): the TRES calibrations, made from robofast's generic templates arc_set, lamp_flat_set and bias_set (the stage to a fiber, the lamp on and its warm-up, the frames, the lamp off, the stage out, a wait; the stage out again in the cleanup), run by observations of kind 'sequence'.

The observers' values, from the live TRES system 2026-11-02, confirm: the nightly calibration (calibration.example.json, with the dome closed) is 5 biases, ThAr 5 x 10 s on the science (object) fiber and 5 x 10 s on the sky fiber, flats 11 x 0.05 s on each fiber, 20 s waits between the groups. Per target: ThAr 5 s (tres_thar, which requests may name), accepted if its line counts are 15k-135k (TODO: robofast does not check this yet; docs/sequences.md). The CCD is read 2x2 binned (TODO: the sequences do not set binning; the camera's own setting is used).
Placeholders, unconfirmed: the lamp warm-ups, the lamp choice (ThAr1, Incand), and the flat exposure and count for the per-request tres_flat (the nightly 11 x 0.05 s).
Each ends with its lamps off and the stage out, and its cleanup puts the stage out whatever happened (cancelled, failed); every lamp it switched on is switched off first.
name: flwo60
